newsitem.title: USA: Daley falls as his U.S. Commerce post announced.
newsitem.headline: Daley falls as his U.S. Commerce post announced.

text.p: Chicago lawyer William Daley collapsed on Friday during a ceremony in which President Bill Clinton's announced he was nominating Daley to be his new commerce secretary.

"I think he's fine, I think he fainted," Clinton said as aides helped Daley to his feet and escorted him out of the room. Daley, 48, returned a short time later, prompting a "welcome back" from Clinton and applause from colleagues.
Daley later was examined by a White House medical team and found to be in good health. He blamed his fainting on the hot room and the fact that he had not eaten lunch.
Daley collapsed shortly after concluding remarks saying he was delighted to become part of Clinton's Cabinet.
